en.text:
While a <stasis/>Stasis Super Ability is equipped:
Class Abilities are replaced by a <stasis/>Stasis Crystal formation.

When used with Rally or Towering Barricade:
• Spawns a <stasis/>Stasis Crystal Wall made of a Small <stasis/>Crystal in the middle and 2 Medium <stasis/>Crystals on either side of it
• Grants Rally Barricade benefits to players standing behind the middle <stasis/>Crystal for 14 seconds, even if destroyed.
• Overrides Class Ability cooldown with Towering Barricade's

When used with <arc/>Thruster:
• Spawns 2 Medium <stasis/>Crystals diagonally forward to either side of you
